issues.description: The template repository's Bitmap24 header declares save(...) as returning int, but the Bitmap24 implementation defines save(...) as void. The solution repository uses void in the header (matching the implementation). This mismatch in the template will cause link/compile errors and contradicts the solution, and it conflicts with the exercise requirement that the project must compile.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template header signature match the implementation and solution: change the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);'. This preserves the intended API used in the implementation and in main.cpp and ensures the project compiles as required.
